name: ELSA
recent: ELSA 近期出现董事及主要股东的股权变动，包括董事总经理 Daniel Ilham Khong 在公开市场增持股份，以及董事在闭门期内的交易意向申报。公司也发布了季度业绩，新闻提及上半年正常化净利为 RM2.8m，并受到上市后一次性项目影响。
notable: 董事总经理 Daniel Ilham Khong 于 2026-10-01 在公开市场增持 5,000,000 股普通股。
公司发布截至 2026-06-30 季度的合并业绩报告。
risks: 董事在闭门期内申报交易意向，涉及多名董事及高管。

recent_en: ELSA recently saw changes in director and substantial shareholder interests, including Managing Director Daniel Ilham Khong acquiring shares in the open market and a director's intention to deal during the closed period. The company also released quarterly results, with news citing 1H normalised net profit of RM2.8m, affected by one-off post-IPO items.
notable_en: Managing Director Daniel Ilham Khong acquired 5,000,000 ordinary shares in the open market on 2026-10-01.
The company released its consolidated quarterly results for the period ended 2026-06-30.
risks_en: Directors declared intentions to deal during the closed period, involving several directors and senior management.
